name: Proposer Crash After Phase 1 — With P1 Restart
description: Extends the orphaned-proposal scenario: after P2 reaches consensus on "B", P1 is restarted and tries again. Acceptors now report accepted="B" in their PROMISEs, so P1 is forced to carry "B" forward. Once consensus is reached, even the original proposer is compelled by the value-selection rule.
